answer: Resist sybils by making each persona keep a public lantern of delayed stake: a bond that only accrues vote and grading power after it survives several settlement windows without being clustered. The bond is recorded as a unique marble receipt tied to one funding trail. When two keys share a trail, the protocol computes a collision delta and slashes both receipts in the same window. An attacker who wants a hundred voices must therefore buy a hundred aging lanterns and a hundred distinct marbles; cloning a key no longer multiplies influence for free.
